description: Teacher-free joint emergence from random communication modules
research_question: Can a group establish a grounded symbol protocol when all communication modules start random, and how does partner-topology coverage affect formation?

training_topologies.rotating_AB: A on even global updates and B on odd global updates
training_topologies.random_ABC: A, B or C sampled from a deterministic per-update schedule

population.communication_initialization: fresh random reset for all agents
population.joint_training: all communication modules update from grounded reward

limits: Only communication modules are newly initialized; private visual encoders are inherited frozen perceptual interfaces.
The task has two resources and one token from each of two complementary senders; it does not test natural-language grammar.
A protocol can be formed by joint policy-gradient coordination here; this is a controlled origin probe, not a reconstruction of human language origins.
